# Go — Wyatt's Notes

> Free, open-access study notes. Part of the Wyatt's Notes network at https://wyattsnotes.wyattau.com

Go is a programming language with a rich type system and ecosystem. These notes cover the language from fundamentals to advanced topics, with worked examples,

All pages are open-access, ad-free, and licensed under AGPLv3.
